sloka: ऋक्षमुख्या महात्मानः कुक्षिम् रक्षन्तु ते त्रयः ।जघनम् कपिसेनायाः कपिराजोऽभिरक्षतु ॥६-२४-१८॥।।
transliteration: ṛkṣamukhyā mahātmānaḥ kukṣim rakṣantu te trayaḥ ।jaghanam kapisenāyāḥ kapirājo'bhirakṣatu ॥6-24-18॥।।

translations.english: "Just as Pracheta who is covered by brilliance, rules the western side of the world, let the king of Vanaras protect the hips and loin portion of the Vanara army."
